headline: Northern Michigan go top before Saginaw Valley State's visit
dek: Northern Michigan have won every match since losing at Wisconsin-Parkside and Purdue Northwest in consecutive outings, and Saginaw Valley State's midweek draw at Davenport let them through. Saginaw Valley State travel to Northern Michigan next.
displaced_by: Northern Michigan have overtaken Saginaw Valley State at the top of the table

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Northern Michigan alone have scored more than Purdue Northwest and St. Cloud State together.

wire.line: Saginaw Valley State have lost once all season, and still have a trip to Northern Michigan to come.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, the earliest of them Northern Michigan's opening match against Green Bay.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Luca Rosen has scored sixteen goals from 74 shots for Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Matty Telfer has scored thirteen of Saginaw Valley State's 31 goals, from 49 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Sergio Cano Castro, a freshman, has ten assists for Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mateusz Pass has made 78 saves for Wisconsin-Parkside while conceding seventeen goals.

last_match.line: Davenport have not won since they beat Purdue Northwest at home the week before.

next_match.line: Each side has already beaten the other at Saginaw Valley State this season.
